description: Point-in-time inventory of raw HTML articles used by the ML pipeline (HTMLArticleExtractor.extract_all). Regenerate when the corpus changes.
notes: Training/inference iterate only files matching article_*.html under raw_articles (any depth).
Samples that fail text extraction (fewer than DataConfig.min_article_chars) are skipped; the number of usable tensors is typically slightly below total_article_html_files.
Parsed metadata for titles/sources comes from parsed_articles/*.json when filenames match the URL-hash convention.
